Alex H.: Quick drop-in for today — 2-line async updates please (what I shipped / blocker / plan). I'll start.
Maria T.: Shipped the canary for the routing-policy PR last night. No errors in staging, a couple small perf diffs to fix later. Blocker: waiting on @Samir P. to confirm fallback metrics look sane. Today: patch the edge-case where kv-cache misses spike.
Samir P.: Looked at the fallback traces this morning. Confirmed logic is OK but the metric bucketing is off by 1s which inflates error rate in Grafana. Blocker: need a short infra rollout window. Today: propose 10–15m during low traffic to deploy metric fix.
Priya S.: Code-review for model-quantize tool pending — replied to comments, resolving tests now. Blocker: one flaky unit test on macos runner. Today: isolating the flake, will push fix by EOD. @Maria T. — expect a follow-up review.
Jules K.: Docs quick note — console rollout notes updated with new canary flags + screenshots. No blocker. Today: sync with growth to add a short how-to.
Alex H.: Re: infra window — +1 to Samir's short rollout. Infra-Bot, could we reserve 11:30–11:45 PT for this?
Infra-Bot: Scheduled maintenance window requested: 1771236900 — 1771237800 (11:30–11:45 PT). Notified infra-oncall.
Samir P.: Perfect, thanks bot. I'll prepare rollout runbook and post in #eng-oncall 10m before.
Maria T.: One ask: can someone eyeball the canary logs for the first 500 requests after the rollout? I can do it but will be heads-down on the cache fix. @Priya S. @Jules K.?
Priya S.: I can take the first 250, then hand off to Jules.
Jules K.: I got the second half.
Alex H.: Awesome — quick CR pings: @Priya S. — your quantize PR might need a changelog note for Optimize.
Priya S.: Noted, adding now.
Samir P.: Blocker aside — any customer-facing alerts? I checked Sentry, nothing new.
Maria T.: No customer alerts. Just internal perf telemetry.
Alex H.: Final: if anyone is blocked on reviews, drop a short DM to me and I'll reassign. Otherwise, post a short follow-up here when you finish so I can compile end-of-day highlights. :thumbsup:
Priya S.: Will update here when tests pass.
Samir P.: Rollout runbook posted in #eng-oncall.
Maria T.: Patch pushed for cache edge-case, running staging smoke.
Jules K.: Docs PR merged.
Alex H.: Thanks team — end-of-thread summary: canary running, metric fix scheduled in maintenance window, cache patch in staging, quantize tests in flight. Ping here with any regressions.
Infra-Bot: Deploy pipeline report: canary pipeline passed, 3 checks, 0 failures. Link: https://ci.redwood.example/builds/12345
